audit_scope.purpose: Assess public datasets as independent evidence for Laya compressor-health summaries; no training, score claims, or production-readiness claim.
audit_scope.search_scope: Primary official repository/publisher records and dataset papers, with targeted web search for multi-asset compressor data. This is not a universal absence search.
audit_scope.boolean_status_convention: Status fields use yes/no/unknown; unknown means not established by sources reviewed, not a claim of absence. Boolean availability/verification fields are true/false where established and null when unknown.
audit_scope.reason: No reviewed source is established here as an independent, compressor-semantics-matched, asset-disjoint evaluation set with verified pointwise physical-fault labels. MetroPT3 and MetroPT2 were already consumed and independence of the recordings/assets is unverified. Other candidates have modality/equipment/task mismatch or weak/coarse/non-pointwise labels.
audit_scope.download_policy: Only public landing pages and HTTP headers/redirects were checked; no large archive was downloaded, and no terms accepted or login performed.

candidates.name: IIT Kanpur Air Compressor Health State Dataset
candidates.citation: N. K. Verma, R. K. Sevakula, S. Dixit and A. Salour, Intelligent Condition Based Monitoring using Acoustic Signals for Air Compressors, IEEE Transactions on Reliability 65(1), 291-309 (2016).
blockers: One reciprocating compressor only; no evidence of independent fleet assets.
Fault conditions were deliberately seeded; does not establish field-fleet transfer.
Acoustic-only, unlike compressor pressure/state summaries.
Landing page links to Google Drive, but no explicit license is stated.
State-level condition labels do not provide verified pointwise physical fault intervals.

evidence.extract: Acoustic dataset was collected on a single stage reciprocating type air compressor
Dataset comprises of 8 states which includes healthy state and 7 faulty states
faults were seeded into the air compressor

access_check.result: Google Drive landing endpoint returned HTTP 307 redirect to public file-view page; bytes/access to dataset not verified; no download attempted.

candidates.name: Vibration, Acoustic, Temperature, and Motor Current Dataset of Rotating Machine Under Varying Load Conditions for Fault Diagnosis
blockers: Rotating machinery testbench, not a compressed-air system or compressor-reservoir telemetry.
Page describes conditions and load but does not establish unique machine IDs or asset-independent partition.
Fault condition keyed by files/condition descriptions, not verified pointwise field fault chronology.

evidence.extract: conditions of the rotating machine include normal, bearing inner race faults, bearing outer race faults, shaft misalignment, and rotor unbalance
Licence CC BY 4.0

access_check.result: Landing page and dataset description readable; Download All link visible; actual archive access/size not verified; no download attempted.

candidates.name: MetroPT-3 Dataset
blockers: Already consumed in current work; cannot serve as independent evaluation.
UCI states one train compressor/APU context; record identifiers (#1, #3, #4) are not proof of four independent compressor assets.
Dataset is explicitly described as unlabeled and relies on company failure reports; intervals are reported proxy, not verified pointwise physical-fault truth.
Research source states acquisition was from the compressor of a train, so years/recording spans cannot be counted as new independent assets.

evidence.extract: readings ... were collected from a compressor's Air Production Unit (APU)
The dataset is unlabeled, but the failure reports provided by the company are available
Copyright ... Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
A signal acquisition system was installed ... of a train

access_check.result: UCI archive endpoint returned HTTP 200; no body downloaded.

candidates.name: MetroPT-2 Dataset
blockers: Already consumed in current work; cannot serve as independent evaluation.
Same MetroPT research/source context cannot be presumed a distinct compressor asset absent verified asset identity.
Report/maintenance-derived condition windows are not verified pointwise physical-fault labels.
Zenodo record page returned HTTP 403 to this read client; record metadata/download access could not be confirmed in this audit.

evidence.extract: Zenodo record page could not be fetched by audit reader (HTTP 403); no source claims verified here.

access_check.result: HTTP 403 in audit reader; no archive download attempted.

candidates.name: APS Failure at Scania Trucks
blockers: Concerns truck air-pressure system and selected component failure class, not compressor sensor time series/pressure state.
Rows are snapshot classification examples, no temporal sequences or machine identity key established for asset grouping.
Feature names are anonymized; class label is component failure versus truck with unrelated failure, not pointwise compressor health.

evidence.extract: data collected from heavy Scania trucks in everyday usage
attribute names ... have been anonymized for proprietary reasons
positive class consists of component failures for a specific component of the APS system

access_check.result: UCI landing page lists a 54 MB downloadable archive; no archive downloaded.

candidates.name: SCANIA Component X Dataset
candidates.asset_independence_basis: Paper specifies disjoint vehicle allocation across train/validation/test (70/15/15) and persistent anonymous vehicle IDs; Component X is an anonymized engine component and is not established as compressor/APU.
candidates.potential_transfer_use: Independent numeric fleet/time-series robustness benchmark only if approved separately; cannot support compressor-specific semantic correctness because component and feature identities are anonymized.
blockers: Component X is an anonymized engine component; no evidence it is an air compressor.
Operational feature identities are anonymized counters/histograms; physical semantics unavailable.
Repair/replacement event is operational label, not time-local verified physical fault onset.

evidence.extract: collected exclusively from a single anonymized engine component (Component X) across a fleet of SCANIA trucks
14 attributes are selected and anonymized in the operational data
70%, 15%, and 15% of vehicles to the training, validation, and testing sets
If the components have been changed or marked as repaired, they will be considered as failed

access_check.result: Paper readable and names Swedish National Data Service repository; dataset archive not accessed or downloaded.

candidates.name: Skoltech Anomaly Benchmark (SKAB) v0.9
blockers: Water-pump circulation testbed, not an air compressor/reservoir system.
Files represent experiments; file count is not asset count and does not establish independently held-out machines.
Benchmark anomaly/changepoint labels describe experimental anomalies, not verified compressor physical failures.
Repository says current corpus v0.9 includes 34 datasets and that testbed collection is under repair; 35-file statement applies to its corpus description and must not be treated as 35 machines.

evidence.extract: Each dataset represents a single experiment and contains a single anomaly
Pressure ... in the loop after the water pump (Bar)
current version of SKAB (v0.9) contains 34 datasets with collective anomalies

access_check.result: Repository files and README accessible; no data archive download needed or attempted.

additional_candidate_search.scope: Targeted search for public multi-asset/operational air-compressor fault datasets, supplemented by official dataset and paper pages.
additional_candidate_search.result: No additional, clearly independent, publicly documented compressor fleet cohort with verified asset identifiers and pointwise physical fault labels was established in this limited search. SCANIA Component X was surfaced as an additional real-world multi-vehicle predictive-maintenance cohort, but is not established to concern compressors and has anonymized component/features.

basis: MetroPT2 and MetroPT3 already consumed and asset independence unresolved.
IITK has one seeded-fault compressor and acoustic-only conditions; no independently held-out physical asset.
Remaining sources mismatch compressor semantics, represent experiment/testbench files rather than proven distinct machines, or provide only anonymized component snapshots.
Reported maintenance intervals are not pointwise verified physical-fault labels.
go_no_go.development_weak_supervision: GO only for explicitly development-only MetroPT report-associated proxy labels, kept distinct from physical-health certification and with all provenance outside inference state.
